target_customer: Independent insurance brokers and agencies and captive agents in the US and Europe
problem: Brokers re-key the same client data into their agency management system, chase documents and fill many carrier portals by hand, so quoting takes hours.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI agent workflows, with a free tier and a two week trial
product_category: AI agents for insurance broker quoting and servicing

founders.name: Tiphaine Venet
previous_startups: Simio (conversational commerce on WhatsApp, acquired by Alcmeon in April 2024)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC company page; press confirms she was Simio CEO.

founders.name: Thibaut Regerat
education: CentraleSupelec, engineering degree in computer science
founders.background_notes: Per the YC company page; no outside source found naming him at Simio.

competitors.name: SUPERAGENT AI
competitors.what: Quoting AI agent that works carrier rating engines

competitors.name: Cara
competitors.what: AI platform automating insurance brokerage workflows

competitors.name: CoverForce
competitors.what: Direct carrier API connectivity for agencies, pitched as no portals and no rekeying

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser and portal automation across 100+ carriers plus integrations with AMS systems like Applied Epic and Vertafore. Portal redesigns can break automations, and carriers may restrict automated access.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with AMS and carriers add some lock-in, but several funded competitors launched similar quoting agents in 2025 and 2026.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found as of 2026-11; competition is from funded startups.

market_need_then: Brokers manually quote across carrier portals and re-key data. Coverage from 2026 describes the quoting bottleneck as a limit on agency growth and a shift of agentic AI toward brokers from carriers.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, results-focused claims such as quote in 3 minutes

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; search returned many similarly named insurtechs such as CoverGo, COVU and CoverForce, and a Corvera YC company.

outcome_analysis: Covera is a new Fall 2026 company from repeat founders whose earlier startup Simio was acquired in 2024. It claims 90 plus brokers live in three months, a vendor figure. Outcome is open. The main risks are crowded AI broker tooling and carrier portal fragility.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed but it is a single aggregator figure, unverified, so no round is recorded. Press describes Simio as WhatsApp conversational marketing, while YC says conversational AI. Website says 50 plus agencies while YC says 90 plus brokers. One directory lists Paris, others San Francisco. Claimed results are vendor figures. No outcome news found.
